title: Reject an old private view after a guarded membership fault
description: Four commanders enter a real development campaign. The owner keeps a partial market allocation, then recovers the campaign with a real private-view digest held by a demo-only harness. A separately labelled administrative fault removes only authorization metadata; the original encrypted state, history, resources and receipts remain intact. Releasing the unchanged digest cannot reopen protected UI. Compare-and-set restoration and ordinary recovery must not resurrect the draft. This is not active Leave gameplay or hosted certification.
